# Selected Onsen Ryokan

> > Curated collection of Japan's finest onsen ryokan featuring private hot springs, open-air baths, and luxury accommodations across regions from Tokyo to Kansai.

Selected Onsen Ryokan showcases handpicked traditional Japanese inns (ryokan) with natural hot spring baths across major regions including Tokyo suburbs, Kansai, Tohoku, and Shikoku. Each property features distinctive characteristics such as private onsens, mountain or ocean views, and cultural heritage settings.

## Key Topics

- Onsen Ryokan
- Private Hot Springs
- Open-Air Bath
- Luxury Ryokan
- Tokyo Suburbs
- Kansai Region
- Tohoku
- Nanki Shirahama Onsen
- Hakone
- Arima Onsen
- Tattoo-Friendly
- Chloride Spring
- Mountain View
- Traditional Japanese Inn

## Premium Tokyo Suburbs & Mt. Fuji Area

- [Fuji Lake Hotel](https://selected-ryokan.com/ryokan/fuji-lake-hotel_mtfuji-lake-kawaguchi_yamanashi_tokyo-suburbs.html): Fuji Lake Hotel at Lake Kawaguchi with Mt. Fuji views & private onsens
- [Okuyugawara Onsen Tsubaki, Yugawara](https://selected-ryokan.com/ryokan/okuyugawara-onsen-tsubaki_hakone_kanagawa_tokyo-suburbs.html): Tsubaki: Exclusive 5-room luxury guesthouse in secluded Yugawara gorge
- [Hakone Pax Yoshino](https://selected-ryokan.com/ryokan/hakone-pax-yoshino_hakone_kanagawa_tokyo-suburbs.html): Hakone Pax Yoshino: All rooms with hot spring baths & mountain views
- [Hotel Oyanagi](https://selected-ryokan.com/ryokan/hotel-oyanagi_yutagami_niigata_tokyo-suburbs.html): Hotel Oyanagi in Yutagami Onsen, Niigata with private baths & rice terrace

## Historic Kansai Region Onsen

- [Arima Onsen Miyukiso Hanamusubi](https://selected-ryokan.com/ryokan/arima-onsen-miyukiso-hanamusubi_hyogo_kansai.html): Miyukiso Hanamusubi in historic Arima Onsen with gold spring baths
- [Hotel Sanrakuso](https://selected-ryokan.com/ryokan/hotel-sanrakuso_nanki-shirahama_wakayama_kansai.html): Hotel Sanrakuso: Ocean-view rooms at Shirahama Beach with 15 private baths
- [Kaishu](https://selected-ryokan.com/ryokan/kaishu_nanki-shirahama_wakayama_kansai.html): Kaishu in Shirahama: Sea views with mixed bathing & 10 detached rooms

## Tohoku Region Cultural Properties

- [Notoya Ryokan](https://selected-ryokan.com/ryokan/notoya_ginzan_yamagata_tohoku.html): Notoya Ryokan: Cultural property inn in historic Ginzan Onsen townscape
- [Sukayu Onsen Ryokan](https://selected-ryokan.com/ryokan/sukayu-onsen-ryokan_aomori_tohoku.html): Sukayu Onsen: Highland hidden bath in Hakkoda Mountains, Aomori

## Mountain & Highland Retreats

- [Hotakaso Yamano Hotel](https://selected-ryokan.com/ryokan/hotakaso-yamano-hotel_oku-hida_gifu_nagoya-chubu-hokuriku.html): Hotakaso Yamano in Okuhida with 1000㎡ mixed open-air bath & Mt. Yarigatake
- [Hotel Hanajukai](https://selected-ryokan.com/ryokan/kiyomisansou-hanajyukai_kagawa_shikoku.html): Hotel Hanajukai in Takamatsu with Seto Inland Sea panoramic views
